entries.heading: The authority provided by the
ancestors: DIVISION G—DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR, ENVIRONMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2021
entries.text:
Sec. 428.  The authority provided by the 
19th unnumbered paragraph under heading ``Administrative Provisions, 
Forest Service'' in title III of Public Law 109-54, as amended, shall be 
applied by substituting ``fiscal year 2021'' for ``fiscal year 2019''.
